summary: Design implementation-ready module boundaries, interfaces, and dependency direction from current project evidence.

outcomes: Choose the smallest maintainable structure that fits current behavior and repository conventions.
Define responsibilities, interfaces, state ownership, failures, increments, and tests before implementation.

scenarios.title: Design a cross-module feature
scenarios.prompt: Use the design-maintainable-code skill to design this non-trivial feature before any source files are edited.
scenarios.outcome: The result fixes concrete module and dependency decisions using the project's existing conventions.

scenarios.title: Evaluate a proposed abstraction
scenarios.prompt: Use the design-maintainable-code skill to decide whether this new interface is justified by the current callers.
scenarios.outcome: The design keeps or rejects the interface from verified variation and maintenance cost rather than preference.
